status: Prelaunch service information. Online payments and prescription uploads are not available in this version. These pages must be reviewed before the live service launches.

sections.title: Privacy notice
sections.body:
NearPill's project team can be contacted at nearpillemail@gmail.com for support and privacy requests. The registered operator name and business address have not yet been supplied; these details will need to be published before live service.

When you register or sign in, the app sends your name, email and password to the NearPill server. Email verification uses your email and a verification code. Profile editing and checkout can also collect a phone number and birthdate. Orders record the medicines, quantities, pharmacy, amounts, order reference, timestamps and status. These details support accounts, order processing, pickup and support. Medicine orders and birthdates require particular privacy care.

The backend stores account and order records in MySQL. New passwords and reset passwords are stored as salted hashes. Legacy development records are upgraded on successful sign-in. The mobile app stores session tokens and the cart using secure storage. The web demo stores its selected role, branch, display name and login time in browser local storage. It uses sample branch and prescription records. Do not submit real prescription or patient information through the demo portal.

The server provides customer order access, admin access, and partner access subject to backend permissions. Authorized operators and staff may receive data needed for their work. Verification email is sent through Resend when configured, otherwise development codes are logged to the server console. Account-security notifications and password-reset links also use Resend when delivery is configured. Hosting and database operators may have operational access; the production providers and storage locations have not been selected or confirmed.

The web portal loads Google Fonts and libraries from cdnjs and jsDelivr. Those providers receive browser requests and associated network information, such as IP addresses. No advertising or behavioral analytics integration was found in this version. Charts inside the portal report application data; they are not evidence of an advertising tracker.

There is currently no automatic deletion schedule for database records. During prelaunch development, records remain until the team removes them. Session records on the server are held in memory; mobile tokens remain until cleared, and the cart remains until cleared or removed. To prevent sign-in abuse, the server temporarily holds IP request timestamps and email-based failure counters. Password-reset records hold a token hash, user ID, email and expiry time for up to 15 minutes, then are removed by periodic cleanup. These security caches are held in memory and cleared on restart. The team must approve retention periods for accounts, orders, audit logs, backups and provider logs before collecting live customer data.

You may email nearpillemail@gmail.com to request access or correction, ask about deletion or blocking, object to processing, or withdraw consent where consent applies. Requests may require proportionate identity checks and may be subject to applicable legal exceptions. Do not email passwords or prescription images. You may also raise privacy concerns with the National Privacy Commission.

This notice explains the current data flow. Reading it does not provide blanket consent to process sensitive information. The legal basis for each live processing purpose, and any separate consent needed for health information or dependent prescriptions, must be established before launch.

sections.title: Orders, cancellations and refunds
sections.body:
This version does not process online charges or refunds. Payment options are previews only. Selecting a full amount or deposit does not transfer money. A payment status stored by NearPill is not proof of a bank or wallet transaction.

The current server permits customers to cancel their own orders before they become ready for pickup or completed, provided the order has not already expired or been cancelled. Cancellation releases reserved inventory. The server expires unclaimed orders after its pickup period, currently three days.

Some cancellation paths mark a paid record as refunded locally; no payment provider is called. This does not confirm that money was returned. There is no verified refund timeline in this version. If you paid a pharmacy separately, contact the pharmacy about that payment and email nearpillemail@gmail.com if you need order support.

Before real payments launch, NearPill will need to publish approved rules for rejected orders, customer cancellations, partial fulfilment, missed pickups, duplicate or failed payments, and defective or incorrect goods, together with the refund method and processing times. Any applicable consumer rights continue to apply.

sections.title: Terms of use for the prelaunch version
sections.body:
NearPill is being developed to help users browse pharmacy listings and submit medicine order requests for pickup. Contact nearpillemail@gmail.com for support. The web operations portal is a demonstration with sample branch data and demo access. Its sign-in does not establish real staff authorization.

Provide accurate account details and use the service only for lawful requests. Do not use another person's account or submit another person's health information without the authority required by law. The current version has no working prescription image upload.

Listings, prices, availability and pharmacy details should be confirmed with the pharmacy. Sample data and missing licence information do not establish that a pharmacy or medicine is licensed, registered, approved, available or suitable for you. No customer review collection or automated licence verification has been established.

A listing is not medical advice or permission to dispense prescription medicine. A qualified pharmacist must make the required prescription and dispensing checks. Do not rely on demo approval controls as clinical verification.

Order requests and payment previews do not prove a successful payment. The cancellation information on this page describes the current server behavior. The live operator, pharmacy responsibilities, payment provider, consumer complaint procedure and final commercial terms must be confirmed before live trading. These terms do not remove rights provided by applicable law.

sections.title: Cookies, browser storage and third parties
sections.body:
The reviewed NearPill code does not set first-party cookies. The web demo uses a browser local storage entry called nearpill_session to remember its selected role, branch, display name and login time across visits. Signing out removes that entry. You can also remove it through your browser's site data settings.

The mobile app uses secure storage for access_token, refresh_token and nearpill_cart. Signing out clears the tokens; it does not currently clear the cart. Uninstalling or clearing application data may also remove locally held information, depending on the platform.

Google Fonts, cdnjs and jsDelivr supply web fonts, icons and charts. Their actual cookie and network behavior must also be checked in the deployed site. This source review does not establish what a hosting provider or future payment SDK will collect.

No optional advertising or analytics controls have been added because no such integration was found. If optional tracking is introduced, the team must assess the applicable consent requirements and provide working choices before enabling it.
